title: 'just setting up my twttr', posted 21 March 2006, before the product was even called Twitter.
description:
'just setting up my twttr', posted 21 March 2006, before the product was even called Twitter. It launched publicly as Twitter four months later, in July 2006.

Jack Dorsey's own first sketch of the idea, drawn on a notepad five years earlier. Nothing came of it until Odeo, a podcasting company, gave the concept a real team in March 2006.

Co-founder Noah Glass chose 'Twitter,' not Dorsey. He took it from the Oxford English Dictionary: 'a short inconsequential burst of information... chirps from birds.'

Entrepreneur Sina Estavi bought it as an NFT for $2.9 million in March 2021. Dorsey converted the proceeds to bitcoin and donated them to charity.

The top bid when Estavi tried to resell that same NFT for $48 million thirteen months later. Seven bids came in; none went higher.
